title: Clean and Unclean Spirit

questions.question: Which land animals were Israelites allowed to eat?
options: Whatever parts the hoof and is cloven-footed and chews the cud
Animals that only part the hoof
questions.correctAnswer: Whatever parts the hoof and is cloven-footed and chews the cud
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:3 (ESV): "Whatever parts the hoof and is cloven-footed and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat."

questions.question: Why was the pig considered unclean?
options: It does not chew the cud
It does not part the hoof
questions.correctAnswer: It does not chew the cud
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:7 (ESV): "The pig, because it parts the hoof... but does not chew the cud, is unclean to you."

questions.question: Which water creatures were clean to eat?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:9 (ESV): "Everything in the waters that has fins and scales... you may eat."

questions.question: What insects were permitted to be eaten?
options: Winged insects that go on all fours and have jointed legs for hopping
questions.correctAnswer: Winged insects that go on all fours and have jointed legs for hopping
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:21 (ESV): "Those that have jointed legs above their feet with which to hop on the ground."

questions.question: What happened if someone touched the carcass of an unclean animal?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:24 (ESV): "Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening."

questions.question: Why was the camel unclean?
options: It parts the hoof but doesn't chew cud
It chews the cud but does not part the hoof
It was a beast of burden
questions.correctAnswer: It chews the cud but does not part the hoof
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:4 (ESV): "The camel, because it chews the cud but does not part the hoof, is unclean to you."

questions.question: What birds were generally forbidden (list includes)?
options: Eagle, vulture, raven, ostrich, owl, bat
questions.correctAnswer: Eagle, vulture, raven, ostrich, owl, bat
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:13-19 lists various birds of prey and scavengers, including the eagle, vulture, raven, ostrich, owl, and bat.

questions.question: What if a carcass fell on an earthenware vessel?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:33 (ESV): "And if any of them falls into any earthenware vessel, all that is in it shall be unclean, and you shall break it."

questions.question: How were clothing/skins purified if water could be used?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:32 (ESV): "It must be put into water and it shall be unclean until the evening; then it shall be clean."

questions.question: What reason did God give for these laws of purity?
options: For I am the Lord your God; consecrate yourselves therefore, and be holy, for I am holy
questions.correctAnswer: For I am the Lord your God; consecrate yourselves therefore, and be holy, for I am holy
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:44 (ESV): "For I am the Lord your God. Consecrate yourselves therefore, and be holy, for I am holy."

questions.question: What creatures that swarm on the ground were detestable?
options: Whatever goes on its belly or on all fours or has many feet
questions.correctAnswer: Whatever goes on its belly or on all fours or has many feet
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:42 (ESV): "Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet... you shall not eat."

questions.question: Was a spring or cistern holding water unclean if a carcass fell in?
options: No, a spring or a cistern holding water shall be clean
questions.correctAnswer: No, a spring or a cistern holding water shall be clean
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:36 (ESV): "Nevertheless, a spring or a cistern holding water shall be clean, but whoever touches a carcass in them shall be unclean."

questions.question: If dry seed had water put on it and a carcass fell on it, was it unclean?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:38 (ESV): "But if water is put on the seed and any part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you."

questions.question: Which specific insect type was listed as clean?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:22 (ESV): "Of them you may eat: the locust... the bald locust... the cricket... and the grasshopper."

questions.question: The rock badger (hyrax) was unclean because?
options: It chews cud but does not part the hoof
It parts the hoof but doesn't chew cud
questions.correctAnswer: It chews cud but does not part the hoof
questions.explanation: Leviticus 11:5 (ESV): "And the rock badger, because it chews the cud but does not part the hoof, is unclean to you."

key_verse_text: For I am the Lord who brought you up out of the land of Egypt to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
